meta.price_source: Yahoo NG=F daily, roll-day returns neutralised, sampled on COT report dates

current.confirm_rule: A peak is confirmed if the front month closes at or below 2.945 (20% under the swing high of 3.681)

scorecard.label: Crowded long
scorecard.rule: MM 3y COT index >= 90

scorecard.label: Crowded short
scorecard.rule: MM 3y COT index <= 10

scorecard.label: Extreme long (Z >= +2)
scorecard.rule: MM net Z-score >= +2

scorecard.label: Extreme short (Z <= -2)
scorecard.rule: MM net Z-score <= -2

scorecard.label: Liquidation after crowded long
scorecard.rule: COT >= 80 within 6w and MM selling over 2w

scorecard.label: Covering after crowded short
scorecard.rule: COT <= 20 within 6w and MM buying over 2w

scorecard.label: Flow blow-off, then selling
scorecard.rule: 4w MM flow > +1.5 sd within 4w, then a selling week

scorecard.label: Flow capitulation, then buying
scorecard.rule: 4w MM flow < -1.5 sd within 4w, then a buying week

scorecard.label: Speculators crowded long, starting to sell
scorecard.rule: MM + Other COT >= 80 and selling over 2w

scorecard.label: Producers heavily short while speculators buy
scorecard.rule: Producer COT <= 20 and MM + Other buying over 2w

scorecard.label: Managed Money surge, Other Reportables selling
scorecard.rule: 4w MM flow > +1 sd while Other Reportables sell over 2w

scorecard.label: Small traders crowded short
scorecard.rule: Non-reportable COT <= 20

scorecard.label: Hedgers selling into strength
scorecard.rule: Swap dealers + producers cut net position by >1% of OI over 2w while price rises
